questions.question: If A = 2⁷ × 3⁵ and B = 3⁵ × 2³, then what is the value of A × B?
questions.solution:
To solve questions of this type, follow the laws of “Surds and indices” given below:

Laws of Indices:

 
• am × aⁿ = a⁽m ⁺ ⁿ⁾
 
• am ÷ aⁿ = a⁽m ⁻ ⁿ⁾
 
• (am)ⁿ = amⁿ
 
• (a)⁻m = 1/am
 
• a⁰ = 1
 
• {( {{a}} )frac{{{m}}{{{n}}}}} = sqrt[{{n}}]{{{{{a}}{m}}}}

Given:

A = 2⁷ × 3⁵ and B = 3⁵ × 2³

Using laws of indices:

A × B =

= (2⁷ × 3⁵) × (3⁵ × 2³)

= (2)⁷ ⁺ ³ × (3)⁵ ⁺ ⁵

= 2¹⁰ × 3¹⁰

∴ A × B = 2¹⁰ × 3¹⁰

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a prime number?
questions.solution:
Prime number: A natural number larger than unity is a prime number if it does not have other divisors except for itself and unity.

As properties of prime number (p):

p > 3, p² - 1 is completely divisible by 24.

From options:

1) 61

⇒ (61² - 1)/24 = (3721 - 1)/24 = 155

2) 71

⇒ (71² - 1)/24 = (5041 - 1)/24 = 210

3) 69

⇒ (69² - 1)/24 = (4761 - 1)/24 = 198.33

4) 67

⇒ (67² - 1)/24 = (4489 - 1)/24 = 187

∴ From above calculation 69 is not a prime number as it does not satisfy prime number properties.

questions.question:
Which of the following statement (s) is/are true?

I. 2 is a prime number

II. 4 is a composite number.
questions.solution:
1) 2 is a prime number:

Prime number: A natural number larger than unity is a prime number if it does not have other divisors except for itself and unity.

⇒ Factors of 2 = 2 and 1 only.

As it satisfy prime number properties so 2 is a prime number.

2) 4 is a composite number.

Composite number: It is a natural number that has at least one divisor different from unity.

⇒ Factors of 4 = 4, 2 and 1.

So, 4 is a composite number.

∴ Both statements are true.

questions.question: Aman purchased an article at a discount of 30% and sold it to Param at 40% profit. What is the ratio between the initial marked price and the price for which Param purchased the article?
questions.solution:
Given,

Let marked price of an article purchased by Aman be Rs.100

Discount = 30%

⇒ Aman purchased an article at = 100 - 100 × (30/100) = 70

Aman purchased an article at Rs.70.

Sold it to Param at 40% profit.

Cost price of an article = Rs.70

⇒ Profit percentage of an article = [(S.P - C.P) / C.P] × 100

⇒ 40 = [(S.P - 70)/70] × 100

⇒ 28 = S.P - 70

⇒ S.P = 98

Param purchased article at Rs.98.

Now, SP for Aman = CP for Param

Required ratio:

= 100 : 98

= 50 : 49

∴ the ratio between the marked price and the price for which Param purchased the article is 50 : 49.

questions.question: An article has a marked price of Rs. 6500 and is available at a discount of 20%. The shopkeeper gives another discount to the buyer and sells the article for Rs. 4160. What is the second discount (in %) offered?
questions.solution:
Given,

Marked price = Rs.6500 and discount = 20%

The price of the article after discount = 6500 - 6500 × (20/100) = 5200

The price of the article after 20% discount = Rs. 5200

The shopkeeper gives another discount to the buyer, its selling price is Rs. 4160.

Let the discount be n%.

⇒ 4160 = 5200 - {5200 × (n/100)}

⇒ 4160 = 5200 - 52n

⇒ n = 20

∴ The second discount is 20%.

Three numbers are in the ratio 2 : 4 : 5. If the sum of their squares is 1620, then what are the number?
questions.solution:
Let three numbers are m, n and p respectively.

Given,

m : n : p = 2 : 4 : 5 and m² + n² + p² = 1620

let m : n : p = k

m = 2k, n = 4k and p = 5k

⇒ m² + n² + p² = 1620

⇒ (2k)² + (4k)² + (5k)² = 1620

⇒ 4k² + 16k² + 25k² = 1620

⇒ 45k² = 1620

⇒ k² = 36

⇒ k = 6

⇒ m = 2k = 12

⇒ n = 4k = 24

⇒ p = 5k = 30

∴ three numbers are 12, 24 and 30 respectively

questions.question: The average of 6 consecutive numbers is 12.5. If the next 3 numbers are also included, then what will be the new average?
questions.solution:
Given, the average of 6 consecutive numbers is 12.5.

Sum of six numbers = 6 × 12.5 = 75

Let 6 consecutive numbers be x - 3, x - 2, x - 1, x, x + 1, x + 2 respectively.

Average = sum of elements / number of elements

⇒ 12.5 = [(x - 3) + (x - 2) + (x - 1) + x + (x + 1) + (x + 2)]/6

⇒ 12.5 = [6x - 3]/6

⇒ x = 13

then the next three numbers are (x + 3), (x + 4) and (x + 5) = 16, 17 and 18

Sum of all 9 numbers = 75 + 16 + 17 + 18 = 126

Average of 9 numbers = 126/9 = 14

∴ New average is 14.

questions.question: A man buys a fan for Rs. 35 and sells it for Rs. 30. What is his loss percent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price = Rs. 30

Cost price = Rs. 35

**Formula used:**

Loss = C.P - S.P

Loss %= [(C.P - S.P)/C.P] × 100

Where, C.P = Cost Price

S.P = Selling Price

**Calculation:**

Loss = C.P - S.P

⇒ Loss = 35 - 30 = Rs. 5

⇒ (5/35) × 100

⇒ 14.28

**∴ Loss percentage is 14.28%.**

questions.question: An article is sold at a loss of 15%. If the selling price is doubled, then what will be the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
Given,

Loss percentage = 15%

Let cost price be Rs.100.

Loss percentage = [(C.P - S.P) / C.P] × 100

⇒ 15 = [(100 - S.P) / 100] × 100

⇒ 15 = 100 - S.P

⇒ S.P = 85

Given,

If the selling price is doubled =

S.P = 85 × 2 = 170

Profit percentage = [(S.P - C.P) / C.P] × 100

= [(170 - 100) / 100] × 100

= 70

∴ when selling price is doubled then profit percentage is 70%.

questions.question: Out of the total pens, 10% of pens are black. 10% of remaining pens are blue. 20% of remaining pens are red. The remaining 648 pens are green. How many total pens are there?
questions.solution:
Let total number of pens be n.

Given,

10% of pens are black,

Number of black pens = (10/100)n = n/10

Remaining number of pens = n - n/10 = 9n/10

Given,

10% of remaining pens are blue,

Number of blue pens = (10/100) × (9n/10) = 9n/100

Remaining number of pens = 9n/10 - 9n/100 = 81n/100

Given,

20% of remaining pens are red,

Number of red pens = (81n/100) × (20/100) = 81n/500

Remaining number of pens = 81n/100 - 81n/500 = 81n/125

Given,

The remaining pens are green = 648

⇒ 81n/125 = 648

⇒ 81n = 648 × 125

⇒ n = 1000

∴ Total number of pens are 1000.

questions.question: A number is increased by 18%. To obtain the old number, by how much percentage should it be decreased?
questions.solution:
Given,

A number is increased by 18%

Let number be n.

New number =

= n + n × (18/100)

= 59n/50

To obtain old number,

Let percentage number should be decreased to obtain new number be a.

n = 59n/50 - (59n/50) × (a/100)

n = (5900n - 59na)/5000

5000n = 5900n - 59na

59na = 900n

a = 900n/59n

a = 15.25

By 15.25% new number should be decreased to obtain new number.

questions.question: Two men are standing on opposite ends of a 1000 metres long bridge. If they walks towards each other with speeds of 20 m/s and 5 m/s respectively, then how much time (in seconds) will they take to meet each other?
questions.solution:
Given,

When two bodies moving in opposite direction with speed a m/s and b m/s then their relative speed is (a + b)m/s

Given,

a = 20m/s and b = 5m/s

Relative speed = 20 + 5 = 25m/s

Distance = 1000m

They will meet each other after =

= 1000 / 25

= 40

They will meet each other after 40seconds.

questions.question: A man goes to a place at a speed of 80 km/hr and comes back with a different speed. If the average speed is 32 km/hr, then what is the return speed (in km/hr)?
questions.solution:
If distance of whole journey is same then average speed of journey is

= (2ab)/(a + b)

a = Speed 1 and b = Speed 2

Given,

Average speed = 32km/hr and traveling speed = 80km/hr

Let the return speed be a km/hr.

⇒ 32 = (2 × 80 × a)/(80 + a)

⇒ 32 = 160a/(80 + a)

⇒ 32(80 + a) = 160a

⇒ 2560 + 32a = 160a

⇒ a = 20

∴ Return speed is 20km/hr.

questions.question: What is the simple interest (in Rs) on a principal of Rs. 1800 at the rate of 8% per annum for 3 years?
questions.solution:
Let P = principle, N = time and R = rate percent per annum

Then,

Simple interest = (P × N × R)/100

Given,

P = 1800, R = 8% and N = 3

Simple interest =

= (1800 × 8 × 3)/100

= 432

∴ Simple interest is Rs.432 on a principal of Rs. 1800 at the rate of 8% per annum for 3 years.
